name: Unipres Corporation
summary: Unipres Corporation engages in manufacture and sale of automotive parts in Japan. The company provides car body frame products, such as front side members, rear side members, cross members, side sills, front pillars, center pillars, side roof rails, front floor panel, steering members, fuel tanks, and filler tubes, as well as battery case. It also offers precision press technology products, including torque converters, clutch pack and drum, driven/retaining plate, piston plunger, carrier pack, carrier plate/base, end plate, oil pan, and parts for cooling EV motors.
